gates_run: 1. WS event classification: verified chat.response is NOT relayed (server.go:941-959, server_wsclass_test.go:42,70); only chat_message topics produce type "chat_message". 2. Per-connection session filter: wsConnSubs structure implements suppression   deletion; unsubscribe records suppression, session-less events broadcast. 3. Runtime spawn guards: StartupOrphanSweep called at daemon.go:1970; no other spawn paths bypass sweep. 4. Auth and pairing: dev_key never logged at info level (server.go:264-266); pairing code single-use via zeroization in pairing.go:138-140. 5. Bus topic integrity: typed Topic[T] enforces payload shape at compile time; raw Publish can miss subscribers if topic mistyped. 6. Log cap: daemon logger uses LogStream (logrotate cap) when set, falls back to os.Stderr for tests/callers; subprocess stderr writes outside rotation seam (components.go:7211, launchd.go:44).

findings.mechanism: transformBusEventToWS explicitly filters out chat.response topic, returning nil (not relayed to WS clients). Test assertions in server_wsclass_test.go:42,70 confirm this invariant.
findings.evidence: grep -n 'chat\.response' internal/comm/http/server_wsclass_test.go shows test asserts chat.response must return nil

findings.mechanism: MessageBus.Publish silently drops messages with no subscribers (direct or wildcard) and logs at DEBUG level. PublishExternalOnly logs at DEBUG. PublishBlocking logs at WARN for dropped security-critical events.
findings.evidence: bus.go:172-202 shows no-subscriber logging logic; bus_test.go:321-347 tests debug logging behavior

findings.mechanism: Subprocess stderr written directly to os.Stderr outside the logrotate rotation seam. While these are not daemon.log writes, unbounded subprocess output could fill disk.
findings.evidence: components.go:7211: cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr; launchd.go:44: cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
findings.test: Verify subprocess stderr is bounded or redirected to a capped writer

findings.mechanism: Dev key warning log includes "default_key_visible": false flag. The key value itself is never logged at any level.
findings.evidence: server.go:264-266: logger.Warn("using development API key", "hint", ..., "default_key_visible", false)
findings.test: Grep for dev_key in logs: grep -rn 'dev_key' internal/ | grep -v 'DevAPIKey()'

findings.mechanism: exchange() performs constant-time comparison and then immediately zeroizes p.code and p.printed, ensuring single-use. Code printed to os.Stdout (not slog), the designed delivery channel.
findings.test: Call handleExchange twice with same code; second call should return failure

findings.mechanism: StartupOrphanSweep is the only path that reaps orphaned runtime processes. Called at daemon.go:1970 during startup. No other spawn paths bypass this sweep.
findings.test: Search for os.StartProcess or similar spawn calls outside of StartupOrphanSweep context

findings.mechanism: Typed Topic[T] enforces payload shape agreement at compile time via PublishT/SubscribeT. Raw Publish can miss subscribers if topic name is mistyped; no compile-time check for raw Publish subscribers.
findings.evidence: topic.go:37-48: PublishT marshals and publishes; bus.go:115: Publish accepts any topic string
findings.test: Run make graphs and check docs/generated/bus-topology.md for topics with publishers but no subscribers
